GRADE 9 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Work: God Worked at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret the scriptures on work to foster responsibility,
   B. Learners should ignore Work: God Worked completely.
   C. Work: God Worked is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work: God Worked.

2. About Work: God Worked at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss virtues related to Christian work ethics,
   B. Learners should ignore Work: God Worked completely.
   C. Work: God Worked is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work: God Worked.

3. About Work: God Worked when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. choose career paths based on their gifts talents and abilities,
   B. Learners should ignore Work: God Worked completely.
   C. Work: God Worked is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Work: God Worked.

5. About Christian Moral Values: Purity at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify moral values that a young person should uphold,
   B. Learners should ignore Christian Moral Values: Purity completely.
   C. Christian Moral Values: Purity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian Moral Values: Purity.

6. About Christian Moral Values: Purity at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible,
   B. Learners should ignore Christian Moral Values: Purity completely.
   C. Christian Moral Values: Purity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian Moral Values: Purity.

7. About Christian Moral Values: Purity when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. utilise Christian moral values and life skills to foster sexual purity,
   B. Learners should ignore Christian Moral Values: Purity completely.
   C. Christian Moral Values: Purity is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Christian Moral Values: Purity.

9. About Judge Deborah at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse qualities portrayed by Deborah as a judge in Israel,
   B. Learners should ignore Judge Deborah completely.
   C. Judge Deborah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Judge Deborah.

10. About Judge Deborah at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. deduce lessons learnt from the leadership of Judge Deborah,
   B. Learners should ignore Judge Deborah completely.
   C. Judge Deborah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Judge Deborah.

11. About Judge Deborah when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse qualities portrayed by Deborah as a judge in Israel,
   B. Learners should ignore Judge Deborah completely.
   C. Judge Deborah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Judge Deborah.

13. About Kings David and Solomon at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. analyse the importance of David as a king and ancestor of Jesus Christ,
   B. Learners should ignore Kings David and Solomon completely.
   C. Kings David and Solomon is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kings David and Solomon.

14. About Kings David and Solomon at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. outline qualities of a good leader from King David’s leadership,
   B. Learners should ignore Kings David and Solomon completely.
   C. Kings David and Solomon is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kings David and Solomon.

15. About Kings David and Solomon when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the achievements and failures of King Solomon,
   B. Learners should ignore Kings David and Solomon completely.
   C. Kings David and Solomon is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kings David and Solomon.

17. About Raising the Widow’s Son at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. elaborate the miracle of raising the Widow’s son,
   B. Learners should ignore Raising the Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Raising the Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Raising the Widow’s Son.

18. About Raising the Widow’s Son at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret lessons learnt from the miracle for application in daily life,
   B. Learners should ignore Raising the Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Raising the Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Raising the Widow’s Son.

19. About Raising the Widow’s Son when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. model the value of compassion as portrayed by Jesus Christ,
   B. Learners should ignore Raising the Widow’s Son completely.
   C. Raising the Widow’s Son is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Raising the Widow’s Son.

21. About Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes at the market in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.

22. About Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes using objects in your classroom, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.

23. About Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes when counting items at home, which statement is correct?
   A. Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers 8 3.3 Parable on Prayer 8 3.4 Nicodemus Encounter with Jes.

25. About Healing the 10 Lepers at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Healing the 10 Lepers using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers.

26. About Healing the 10 Lepers at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Healing the 10 Lepers at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers.

27. About Healing the 10 Lepers when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Healing the 10 Lepers helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Healing the 10 Lepers completely.
   C. Healing the 10 Lepers is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Healing the 10 Lepers.

29. About Parable on prayer Midnight at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. elaborate the parable of a friend at midnight,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable on prayer Midnight completely.
   C. Parable on prayer Midnight is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable on prayer Midnight.

30. About Parable on prayer Midnight at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret lessons learnt from the parable of a friend at midnight,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable on prayer Midnight completely.
   C. Parable on prayer Midnight is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable on prayer Midnight.

31. About Parable on prayer Midnight when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply lessons learnt from the parable in daily life,
   B. Learners should ignore Parable on prayer Midnight completely.
   C. Parable on prayer Midnight is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Parable on prayer Midnight.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Work: God Worked at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Christian Moral Values: Purity at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Judge Deborah at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Kings David and Solomon at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Raising the Widow’s Son at home with your family.
